@@ -13,9 +13,9 @@

Train LLMs, VLMs, diffusion, and embodied models — faster.

- Docs ↗︎ + Docs  ·  - Blog ↗︎ + Blog  ·  Performance  ·  @@ -50,13 +50,13 @@ **LoongForge** is an open-source training framework developed by the [Baidu AI Cloud Baige team](https://cloud.baidu.com/product/aihc.html), built to deliver faster training for mainstream **LLMs, VLMs, diffusion, and embodied models**. -- **High Performance** — Built on a multi-backend architecture (Megatron-LM and torch-native), with [deep training-speed](#performance) optimizations that keep **training loss aligned with the baseline**. -- **Easy to Use** — Covers 40+ mainstream open-source [models](#models), each with ready-to-run configs and launch examples. Ships with supporting tools such as checkpoint conversion and data preprocessing, and supports **pre-training**, **continued pre-training**, **SFT**, and **LoRA**. -- **Production-Proven** — Open-sourced from [AIAK-Training-LLM](https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/AIHC/s/Alyo476jr), a training suite that serves enterprise customers' proprietary models and also powers some [awesome projects](#powered-by-loongforge), with its largest validated scale for large-model training reaching **5,000+ XPUs**. +- **High Performance** — Built on Megatron-LM and torch-native backends, with deep optimizations for [training speed](#performance) that keep **training loss aligned with the baseline**. +- **Easy to Use** — Ready-to-run configs and launch scripts for 40+ open-source [models](#models), plus checkpoint conversion and data preprocessing tools. Supports **pre-training**, **mid-training**, **SFT**, and **LoRA**. +- **Production-Proven** — Open-sourced from [AIAK-Training-LLM](https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/AIHC/s/Alyo476jr), which powers enterprise customers' proprietary models and several [open-source projects](#powered-by-loongforge). Production runs reach **5,000+ XPUs**. --- -**Example:** training the embodied model DreamZero (full fine-tuning of Wan2.2-5B) on LoongForge reaches 4.38× the open-source baseline's throughput, with loss curves staying aligned +**Example:** training the embodied model DreamZero on LoongForge reaches 4.38× the open-source baseline's throughput, with loss curves staying aligned

@@ -50,13 +50,13 @@ **LoongForge** 是百度智能云 [百舸团队](https://cloud.baidu.com/product/aihc.html) 打造的开源训练框架，旨在加速主流 **LLM、VLM、Diffusion 与具身模型**的训练。 -- **高性能** —— 基于多后端架构（Megatron-LM 与 torch-native），[深度优化训练速度](#performance)，同时保证**训练 loss 与基线对齐**。 -- **易用性** —— 已覆盖 40+ 个主流开源[模型](#models)，每个模型均附带开箱即用的配置与启动示例；框架另提供权重转换、数据预处理等配套工具，并支持**预训练**、**持续预训练**、**SFT** 与 **LoRA** 等训练方式。 -- **源自生产** —— 前身为 [AIAK-Training-LLM](https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/AIHC/s/Alyo476jr)，既落地于企业客户的闭源模型训练，也支撑了[不少优秀项目](#powered-by-loongforge)；在大模型训练中，最大验证规模达 **5,000+ XPU**。 +- **高性能** —— 基于 Megatron-LM 与 torch-native 后端，在[深度优化训练速度](#performance)的同时，保证**训练 loss 与基线对齐**。 +- **易用性** —— 支持 40+ 个开源[模型](#models)，并附带开箱即用的配置与启动示例，另有权重转换、数据预处理等配套工具；覆盖**预训练**、**中期训练**、**SFT** 与 **LoRA**。 +- **源自生产** —— 前身为 [AIAK-Training-LLM](https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/AIHC/s/Alyo476jr)，既落地于企业客户的闭源模型训练，也支撑了[多个开源项目](#powered-by-loongforge)；在实际生产中，最大训练规模达 **5,000+ XPU**。 --- -**示例**：在 LoongForge 上训练具身模型 DreamZero（Wan2.2-5B 全参微调），吞吐达开源基线的 4.38 倍，loss 曲线保持对齐 +**示例**：在 LoongForge 上训练具身模型 DreamZero，吞吐达开源基线的 4.38 倍，loss 曲线保持对齐
